sermon.title: Jesus Christ’s Counterattack to Satan’s Secret Weapons 07/22/18
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer finishes the parable of the sower: the good ground receives the word with an honest heart, obeys it, and bears fruit with patience. Then he gives Jesus Christ’s counterattack to Satan’s weapons: God restores and heals those on the path, the rock and among thorns, and restores the years the locusts have eaten.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Real people described: a young man named David who later overdosed (5:00–6:40); a parole-referred couple who lost their children (6:44–8:50).

chunks.section_question: How does God make you a tree of righteousness?
chunks.short_answer: He gives beauty for ashes and the oil of joy for mourning, and you will be called trees of righteousness. The mightiest oak was once a tiny seed that patiently grew; if you keep following God through the week, you will become a mighty oak.

faqs.question: What do all four soils have in common?
Do demons believe?
faqs.answer: Yes; belief is not the goal, doing good is.

faqs.question: Why did he refuse further help to the woman years later?
faqs.answer: He said he would not enable someone who rejected the help already given.

faqs.question: What is the farmer waiting for?
faqs.answer: Not the sprout, but the fruit.

faqs.question: Does anyone know when Christ returns?
faqs.answer: No one knows; he says get ready for a long life here.

faqs.question: Can every believer have the fruit of the Spirit?
faqs.answer: You can’t have every gift, but everybody can have the fruit of the Spirit.

scriptures.text_nkjv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control. Against such there is no law.

faqs.question: Can the least educated person understand the Bible?
faqs.answer: Yes, because it is wrapped up in the two commandments.

faqs.question: What is the only thing you may test God in?
What softens a hard heart?
faqs.answer: Water: the Holy Spirit and the water of the word.

faqs.question: Which fruit does he say he lacked?
